currentWork.title: Operational evidence accumulation — FINAL.18 OCR visit-flow maintenance verified
currentWork.releaseStatus: FINAL.18 is merged and live-verified. Compact OCR rerenders now preserve the active visit callbacks, so corrected sales-journal reviews retain their Analytics visit and post-confirm continuation/end actions. Explicit OCR visit closeout now routes the trusted matching Today machine through the existing normal visit-completion flow; the existing task checklist and order confirmation remain authoritative. Closing the OCR modal alone does not complete Today. PR #108 is merged, the matching Vercel production deployment is READY, GitHub Pages serves FINAL.18, and both the visit-closeout/overlap gate and existing OCR field regression gate pass on production and live GitHub Pages. Analytics engine remains AN14B3B3; DB/schema remain 4.
scope: Use VENDRIVE normally in field operations; no active feature phase is open.
Corrected OCR reviews must preserve visit continuity and post-confirm actions across rerenders.
Explicit OCR visit closeout may complete the matching Today machine only through the existing normal visit-completion flow.
Keep task checklist and order confirmation behavior unchanged and authoritative.

Keep no auto-confirm, no auto-link, no numeric forecasting change, and no DB/schema migration.
